visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Pattern Is Not Anchored
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 5555-12345 is not a valid phone number (3 digits, dash, 4 digits), but the program says true.

solution.explanation: Without ^ and $ the pattern only has to match somewhere inside the text, and 5555-12345 contains 555-1234. The anchors force the whole text to match.
